name: The Weave
idea: Three players hand the ball off and run behind each other all the way to the basket.
why: The weave teaches you to keep moving after you give up the ball. Keep running, and you’ll always be ready for the next handoff.
tryit: Try it in threes from one end of the gym to the other. The rule: after you hand it off, run behind the player you gave it to.

frames.say: The weave is a warm-up drill. Three players race down the court, handing the ball off as they go.
{1} dribbles toward {3} and hands it off. Then {1} runs behind {3}.
{3} dribbles toward {2}, hands it off, and runs behind {2}.
{2} hands it to {1}, who is running straight at the basket.
Layup! Hand off, run behind, and keep going. That’s the weave.
